earnings.title: October 20, 2026
highlights: Operating margin was 34.6%, up from 28.2% in Q3’25 and ahead of our forecast primarily due to the timing of expenses.
outlook: Q3 revenue grew 12% year over year (11% on a F/X neutral basis 1 ) to $12.9B, consistent with our forecast.
For 2026, we expect revenue of $51.1B (+13% year over year) and an operating margin of 31.5%.
Revenue in Q3 grew 12% year over year (+11% on a foreign exchange (F/X) neutral basis), and was in-line with our forecast.
In Q4, we expect revenue of $13.4 billion, which represents year over year growth of 12% (or 11% F/X neutral) driven by growth in memberships, pricing, and ad revenue.
